Title: EVT-OP-009: Circular block maxima: a variance advantage under non-stationarity
Labels: open-problem, area:statistics, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT conjecture. Listed for completeness in the survey.

## Source and quote
Bücher and Staud, arXiv:2409.05529v2, conclusion:

> Respective methods could be studied mathematically under a suitable triangular array structure, and we conjecture that advantages over the disjoint block maxima method will eventually show up in respective estimation variances.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
Uncertainty for 100-year return levels from seasonal data.

## What the library already has
Block-maxima empirical c.d.f. convergence; GEV moments and probability-weighted moments.

## What is missing
Almost everything: triangular arrays and the bootstrap.
